arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنَّهُ لاَ وَفَاءَ لِي بِالتَّوْبَةِ إلاَّ بِعِصْمَتِكَ، وَلا اسْتِمْسَاكَ بِي عَنِ الْخَطَايَا إلاَّ عَنْ قُوَّتِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa innahu lā wafā'a li bi-tawbah illā bi-ʿismatika walā istim'sāka bī ʿani al-khaṭāyā illā ʿan qawwatika
english_text: O God, but I can not be faithful to my repentance without Thy preservation, nor can I refrain from offenses without Thy strength.

arabic_text: فَقَوِّنِي بِقُوَّة كَافِيَة، وَتَوَلَّنِي بِعِصْمَة مَانِعَة.
transliteration: faqawwinī biqūwata kāfiyah, wa tawallanī biʿismah māniʿah
english_text: So strengthen me with a sufficient strength and attend to me with a defending preservation!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ أَيُّما عَبْد تَابَ إلَيْكَ وَهُوَ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ فَاسِخٌ لِتَوْبَتِهِ وَعَائِدٌ فِي ذَنْبِهِ وَخَطِيئَتِهِ فَإنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أنْ أَكُوْنَ كَذلِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ayyuma ʿabdin tāba ilayk wa huwa fi ʿilmi al-ghaybi ʿindaka fāsikhun li-tawbatihi waʿāʾidun fī dhambihi wa khateeʾatih fa inni aʿūdhu bika an akūna kadhalik
english_text: O God, if any servant repents to Thee, while in Thy knowledge of the Unseen he will break his repentance and return to his sin and offense, I seek refuge in Thee lest I be like that!

arabic_text: فَاجْعَلْ تَوْبَتِي هَذِهِ تَوْبَةً لا أَحْتَاجُ بَعْدَهَا إلَى تَوْبَة، تَوْبَةً مُوجِبَةً لِمَحْوِ مَا سَلَفَ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِيمَـا بَقِيَ.
transliteration: fajʿal tawbati hadhihi tawbatan la ahtaju baʿdaha ila tawbah tawbatun mu'jibatun li mahwi ma salafa, wa al-salamati fi ma baqiya
english_text: So make this my repentance a repentance after which I will need no repentance and a repentance which will obligate the erasing of what has gone by and safety in what remains!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعْتَـذِرُ إلَيْـكَ مِنْ جَهْلِي، وَأَسْتَـوْهِبُـكَ سُوْءَ فِعْلِي،
transliteration: allāhumma innī aʿtaḏiru ilayka min jahlī wa-astawhibuka suu'a fi'liyyi
english_text: O God, I ask pardon from Thee for my ignorance, and I ask Thee to disregard my evil acts!

arabic_text: فَـاضْمُمْنِي إلَى كَنَفِ رَحْمَتِكَ تَطَوُّلاً، وَاسْتُرْنِي بِسِتْرِ عَافِيَتِكَ تَفَضُّلاً.
transliteration: faẓmumnee ilaa kanafi rahmatika taṭawwulan wa asturni bisitr 'afiyatika tafaddulan
english_text: So join me to the shelter of Thy mercy through graciousness and cover me with the covering of Thy well-being through bounteousness!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا خَالَفَ إرَادَتَكَ أَوْ زَالَ عَنْ مَحَبَّتِـكَ مِنْ خَـطَرَاتِ قَلْبِي
transliteration: allāhumma wa innī atūbu ilayka min kulli ma khalafa iradataka ʾaw zāla ʿan maḥabbatika min khaṭarāti qalbī
english_text: O God, I repent to Thee from everything opposed to Thy will or far from Thy love - the thoughts of my heart,

arabic_text: وَلَحَـظَاتِ عَيْنِي وَحِكَايَاتِ لِسَانِي، تَوْبَةً تَسْلَمُ بِهَا كُلُّ جَارِحَة عَلَى حِيَالِهَا مِنْ تَبِعَاتِكَ، وَتَأْمَنُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ مِنْ أَلِيْمِ سَطَوَاتِكَ.
transliteration: walahaẓāti ʿaynī wa ḥikāyāt li-sānī tawbatan taslamu biha kullu jarīhah ʿalā ḥiyālihā min tabiʿātika wa ta'manu mimma yakhafu almu'tadun min 'aleemi satawatak
english_text: the glances of my eye, the tales of my tongue - with a repentance through which each bodily part will by itself stay safe from ill consequences with Thee and remain secure from Thy painful penalties feared by transgressors!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ فَارْحَمْ وَحْدَتِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَوَجِيبَ قَلْبِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ، وَاضْطِرَابَ أَرْكَانِي مِنْ هَيْبَتِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma fārham waḥdatī bayna yadayka wa wajība qalbī min khashyatika waḍṭirāba arkānī min haybatika
english_text: O God, so have mercy on my being alone before Thee, the pounding of my heart in dread of Thee, the trembling of my limbs in awe of Thee!

arabic_text: فَقَدْ أَقَامَتْنِي يَا رَبِّ ذُنُوبِي مَقَامَ الْخِزْيِ بِفِنَائِكَ،
transliteration: faqad aqamatanee ya rabbi dhunoo-bee maqama al-khiz-y bi finaa-ika
english_text: My sins, my God, have stood me in the station of degradation in Thy courtyard.

arabic_text: فَإنْ سَكَتُّ لَمْ يَنْطِقْ عَنِّي أَحَدٌ،
transliteration: fa'in sakti lam yantiq 'anni ahadun
english_text: If I remain silent, none will speak for me;

arabic_text: وَإنْ شَفَعْتُ فَلَسْتُ بِأَهْلِ الشَّفَاعَةِ.
transliteration: wa-in shafaʿtu, falastu bi-ahli ash-shafaʿah
english_text: if I seek an intercessor, I am not worthy for intercession.

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَشَفِّعْ فِي خَطَايَـايَ كَرَمَكَ، وَعُدْ عَلَى سَيِّئاتِي بِعَفْوِكَ، وَلاَ تَجْزِنِي جَزَآئِي مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa shaffiʿ fi khaṭāyāya karamak waʿud ʿalā sayyiātī biʿafwik wa lā tajzīnī jazāʾī min ʿuqūbatik
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, make Thy generosity intercede for my offenses, follow up my evil deeds with Thy pardon, repay me not with the punishment that is my proper repayment,

arabic_text: وَابْسُطْ عَلَيَّ طَوْلَكَ وَجَلِّلْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ، وَافْعَلْ بِي فِعْلَ عَزِيز تَضَرَّع إلَيْهِ عَبْدٌ ذَلِيلٌ فَرَحِمَهُ، أَوْ غَنِيٍّ تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ فَقِيرٌ فَنَعَشَهُ.
transliteration: wa-apsuṭ ʿalayya ṭawlika wa-jallilnī bisitrika wafʿal biyyi fiʿla ʿazīz tadarraʿa ilayhi ʿabdu dhaleelun farahimahu aw ghaniyyin taʿarradha lahu ʿabdun faqirun fanʿashahu
english_text: spread over me Thy graciousness, wrap me in Thy covering, and do with me what is done by a mighty man, when a lowly slave pleads to him and he shows him mercy, or a rich man, when a poor slave submits himself and he raises him to wealth!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ خَفِيرَ لِي مِنْكَ فَلْيَخْفُرْنِيْ عِزُّكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma lā khafīra lī minka falyakhfurnī ʿizzuka
english_text: O God, I have no protector against Thee, so let Thy might be my protector!

arabic_text: وَلا شَفِيعَ لِيْ إلَيْكَ فَلْيَشْفَعْ لِي فَضْلُكَ،
transliteration: wa lā shafīʿa lī ʾilayka falyashfaʿ lī faḍluka
english_text: I have no intercessor with Thee, so let Thy bounty be my intercessor!

arabic_text: وَقَدْ أَوْجَلَتْنِي خَطَايَايَ فَلْيُؤْمِنِّي عَفْوُكَ،
transliteration: wa qad awjalatnī khaṭāyāy fa-lyuʾminnī ʿafwuk
english_text: My offenses have set me quaking, so let Thy pardon give me security!

arabic_text: فَمَا كُلُّ مَا نَطَقْتُ بِهِ عَنْ جَهْل مِنِّي بِسُوْءِ أَثَرِي، وَلاَ نِسيَان لِمَا سَبَقَ مِنْ ذَمِيمِ فِعْلِي، وَلكِنْ لِتَسْمَعَ سَمَاؤُكَ وَمَنْ فِيْهَـا، وَأَرْضُكَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا مَا أَظْهَرْتُ لَكَ مِنَ النَّدَمِ،
transliteration: famā kullu mā naṭaqtu bihī ʿan jahl minnī bisūʾi atharī walā nisyān limā sabqa min ḏamīm fiʿlī walakin litasmaʿa samāʾuka wa-man fīhā wa-arḍuka wa-man ʿalayhā mā aẓhar-tu laka minan-nadam
english_text: Not all that I have said rises up from my ignorance of my evil footsteps or forgetfulness of my blameworthy acts in the past, but in order that Thy heaven and those within it and Thy earth and those upon it may hear the remorse which I have professed to Thee

arabic_text: وَلَجَـأتُ إلَيْكَ فِيـهِ مِنَ التَّوْبَـةِ،
transliteration: walajaʾtu ʾilayka fiihi mina l-tawba
english_text: and the repentance through which I have sought asylum with Thee.

arabic_text: فَلَعَـلَّ بَعْضَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَرْحَمُنِي لِسُوءِ مَوْقِفِي، أَوْ تُدْرِكُهُ الرِّقَّةُ عَلَىَّ لِسُوءِ حَالِي
transliteration: falaʿalla baʿḍahum birahmatika yarhamunī lisuʾi mawqifī aw tudrikuhu ar-riqqaẗu ʿalayya li-suʾi ḥālī
english_text: Then perhaps one of them, through Thy mercy, may show mercy upon my evil situation or be seized by tenderness for my evil state.

arabic_text: فَيَنَالَنِي مِنْهُ بِدَعْوَةٍ أَسْمَعُ لَدَيْكَ مِنْ دُعَائِي، أَوْ شَفَاعَـةٍ أَوْكَدُ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَفَاعَتِي تَكُونُ بِهَا نَجَاتِي مِنْ غَضَبِكَ وَفَوْزَتِي بِرضَاكَ.
transliteration: fayanālanī minhu bidʿawatin asmāʿu ladayka min duʿāʾī aw shafaʿatin awkadu ʿindaka min shafaʿati takūnu bihā najātī min ghaḍabika wa fawzatī biriḍāk
english_text: There may come from him for my sake a supplication to which Thou givest ear more than to my supplication or an intercession surer with Thee than my intercession through which I may be delivered from Thy wrath and attain to Thy good pleasure!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنْ يَكُنِ النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةً إلَيْكَ فَأَنَا أَنْدَمُ اْلنَّادِمِينَ،
transliteration: allāhumma in yakuni an-nadamu tawbatan ilayka fa-anā andamu al-nādimīna
english_text: O God, if remorse is a repentance toward Thee, then I am the most remorseful of the remorseful!

arabic_text: وَإنْ يَكُنِ التَّرْكُ لِمَعْصِيَتِكَ إنَابَةً فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُنِيبينَ،
transliteration: wa in yakin al-turku limaʿṣiyatika inābatan fa-anā awwalu al-munībīn
english_text: If refraining from disobedience is a turning back to Thee, then I am the first of those who turn back!

arabic_text: وَإنْ يَكُنِ الاسْتِغْفَارُ حِطَّةً لِلذُّنُوبِ فَإنَي لَكَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ.
transliteration: wa in yakun al-istighfāru ḥiṭṭah li-l-ḏunūbi fa-ʾinnī laka mina l-mustaghfirīn
english_text: If praying for forgiveness alleviates sins, surely I am one of those who pray for Thy forgiveness!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَمَرْتَ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَضَمِنْتَ الْقَبُولَ وَحَثَثْتَ عَلَى الدُّعَـاءِ وَوَعَدْتَ الإجَابَةَ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَآلِهِ وَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي وَلاَ تَرْجِعْني مَرجَعَ الخَيبَةِ منْ رَحْمَتِك
transliteration: allāhumma fakamā amarta bi-t-tawbah waḍaminta-l-qabūla wa-haththatha ʿala ad-duʿa'i wa-waʿadtal-ijābah faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa aqbal tawbatī wa lā tarjīʿnī marjaʿa al-khaybah min raḥmatik
english_text: O God, as Thou hast commanded repentance and guaranteed acceptance, as Thou hast urged supplication, and promised to respond, so also bless Muhammad and his Household, accept my repentance, and return me not to the returning place of disappointment in Thy mercy!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ عَلَى الْمُذْنِبِينَ، وَالرَّحِيمُ لِلْخَاطِئِينَ الْمُنِيبِينَ.
transliteration: innak anta at-tawwābu ʿalā al-mudhnibīn wa al-raḥīmu li-l-khāṭiʾīna al-munībīna
english_text: Surely Thou art "Ever-turning" (2:128) toward the sinners, "All-compassionate" (2:128) toward the offenders who turn back!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا هَدَيْتَنَا بِهِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī kamā hadaytanā bihī
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household just as Thou hast guided us by him!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا اسْتَنْقَذْتَنَا بِهِ،
transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī kamā istanqaẓtanā bihi
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household just as Thou hast rescued us through him!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً تَشْفَعُ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَوْمَ الْفَاقَةِ إلَيْكَ،
transliteration: waṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi. ṣalātan tashfaʿu lanā yawm al-qiyāmati wa yawm al-fāqati ilayka
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household, with a blessing that will intercede for us on the Day of Resurrection, the day of neediness toward Thee!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ .
transliteration: ʾinnaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr wa huwa ʿalayka yasīr
english_text: "Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26), and that is easy for Thee!
